# Our Many Worlds

> Our Many Worlds is an AI shared-world social strategy game. Every role enters the same crisis with different goals, private information, relationships, resources, and leverage. Players can talk, investigate, bargain, use leverage, or make a move in their own words. AI resolves human and AI-controlled actions into one evolving world, so each decision can change what other players know, believe, and are able to do.

## Canonical pages

- Home: https://ourmanyworlds.com/
- Explore worlds: https://ourmanyworlds.com/worlds
- Caesar: The Last Spring of the Republic: https://ourmanyworlds.com/worlds/caesar
- Sangtian Edict: The Jiajing Fiscal Crisis: https://ourmanyworlds.com/worlds/sangtian
- World Credits: https://ourmanyworlds.com/credits

## Core experience

- Solo or multiplayer browser play.
- Different goals, secrets, and limited points of view for every role.
- Shared consequences: one player's move can change another player's options.
- Four core actions: talk, investigate, use leverage, and make a custom move.
- AI acts as world simulator, unfilled-role performer, and narrator of consequences.
- Designed worlds have rules and constraints; outcomes are not predetermined.

## Terminology

Preferred category description: AI shared-world social strategy game.
Related descriptions: AI multiplayer story game, multiplayer interactive story game, historical roleplay game, asymmetric-information story game, solo AI story game.
